The data is visualized through three donut charts, each representing a different category, with a total of four sectors in each chart. The sectors are labeled as industry (yellow), construction (blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue). In the "Number of Enterprises" chart, other services account for 61% (19.0 million), trade for 19% (5.9 million), construction for 12% (3.7 million), and industry for 8% (2.4 million). The "Number of Persons Employed" chart shows other services at 51% (80.2 million), trade at 21% (33.0 million), industry at 19% (29.5 million), and construction at 9% (13.4 million). The "Turnover" chart displays industry at 33% (10.6 trillion), trade at 31% (9.9 trillion), other services at 31% (9.8 trillion), and construction at 6% (1.9 trillion). A legend is provided at the bottom left, explaining the color coding for each sector. The charts are arranged side by side, allowing for a visual comparison across the categories. The data is sourced from Eurostat.
